description: This file contains utility functions for handling parametric product searches based on product features, feature categories, and related entities in an OFBiz-based e-commerce system. It includes methods for retrieving features by category, type, and other filters, as well as parsing HTTP request parameters to identify selected product features.

classes.name: ParametricSearch
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for retrieving and processing product feature data and user parameters for parametric search in an e-commerce context.

methods.name: makeCategoryFeatureLists
methods.description: Retrieves a map of product features associated with a given category, organized by feature type, considering maximum sizes per type.

methods.name: makeCategoryFeatureLists
methods.description: Overloaded version that allows specifying maximum features per feature type.

methods.name: getAllFeaturesByType
methods.description: Retrieves all product features grouped by feature type, with optional size limiting.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdByTypeMap
methods.description: Builds a map linking product feature types to selected feature IDs from HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdListFromPrefixed
methods.description: Generates a list of feature IDs from request parameters prefixed with 'SEARCH_FEAT'.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdByTypeString
methods.description: Converts a map of feature type to feature ID into a string suitable for URL or parameter passing.

methods.name: makeProductFeatureCategoryIdListFromPrefixed
methods.description: Extracts a list of product feature category IDs from request parameters prefixed with 'SEARCH_PROD_FEAT_CAT'.
